summary: A resident of {place} asks to see the district's shortage plan before the next round of water decisions.
realLife: State officials were to encourage water suppliers to submit their plans on time and make urban shortage and agricultural drought plans publicly available.
gates: The supplier's plan register shows the plan type and publication status.
inGame: needs: the supplier's plan register shows the plan type and publication status.

turns.pulledBy: The plan has a current public copy.
turns.what: Give the resident the dated public copy.
Ask the district when residents can see the plan.
